title: Antenna
text: Model antenna or antenna array accounting for incident power wave (RX) and radiated power wave (TX), 1 input, 1 output, {Antenna Gain} sets Antenna gain 0; {Source of antenna model} sets the antenna model Isotropic, {Create Antenna} sets the open Antenna Toolbox Antenna Designer app, {Antenna object} sets the antenna or array element input from workspace antenna catalog, {Impedance (Ohm)} sets the input impedance, {Input incident wave}, {Output radiated wave}, {Incident carrier frequencies} sets the carrier frequencies for receiving signal, {Radiated carrier frequencies} sets the carrier frequencies for transmitting signal, {Direction of departure} sets the azimuth and elevation angles towards which output signal power wave radiates, {Direction of arrival} sets the azimuth and elevation angles from which input signal power wave arrives, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Modeling options} sets the model frequency-dependent antenna parameters Time, {Relative error desired (dB)} sets the relative error acceptable for the rational, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} sets the automatically calculate impulse response and {Impulse response duration}. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Open Antenna Toolbox Antenna Designer app button

params.values: Antenna or array element input from workspace antenna catalog object | antenna array catalog object | measuredAntenna object | pcbstack object

params.name: Antenna Gain
params.values: Antenna gain 0 dBi (default) | real scalar or vector | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Impedance (Ohm)
params.values: Input impedance 50 (default) | complex-valued scalar or vector

params.name: Input incident wave
params.values: Input incident wave for simulating receiving antenna ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Output radiated wave
params.values: Output radiated wave for transmitting antenna ’on’ (default) | ’off’

params.name: Incident carrier frequencies
params.values: Carrier frequencies for receiving signal 2.1 GHz (default) | nonnegative scalar or row vector

params.name: Radiated carrier frequencies
params.values: Carrier frequencies for transmitting signal 2.1 GHz (default) | nonnegative scalar or row vector

params.name: Direction of departure
params.values: Azimuth and elevation angles towards which output signal power wave radiates [0 0] deg (default) | finite real row vector of length 1-by-2 | finite real matrix of length m -by-2

params.name: Direction of arrival
params.values: Azimuth and elevation angles from which input signal power wave arrives [180 0] deg (default) | finite real row vector of length 1-by-2 | finite real matrix of length m -by-2

params.name: Modeling options
params.values: Model frequency-dependent antenna parameters Time domain (default) | Frequency domain

params.values: Relative error acceptable for the rational fit -40 (default) | scalar
